meta.title: WEB-05 B2C Commerce Demo
meta.description: Enterprise Platform Phase 7 WEB-05 demo — a live, anonymous-guest B2C storefront (browse, cart, checkout with a real server-computed price) for a demo distributor company, powered by live demo data generated and managed by the connected ERP system, served from a guest-writable Frappe API.

home.title: Buy Vitamin C and Facial Cleanser direct from Demo Consumer Distribution Co.
home.lead: Browse our catalog, add items to your cart, and check out as a guest — no account needed. Every price you see is live demo data generated and managed by our connected ERP system; the price you're actually charged is confirmed by our system at checkout.
home.catalogUnavailable: Catalog is temporarily unavailable — please try again shortly.

howItWorks.heading: How ordering works on this demo
howItWorks.noAccount: No account or login required — add items to your cart and check out as a guest.
howItWorks.cod: Payment is Cash on Delivery only — no real payment gateway is used anywhere on this site.
howItWorks.trackNote: After checkout you'll get an order reference — use it with your phone number on the <trackLink>Track Order</trackLink> page to check your order's status.

shop.title: Shop
shop.subtitle: Live demo data — products and prices generated and managed directly by our connected ERP system.
shop.loadError: Could not load the catalog right now — please try again shortly.
shop.priceNote: Prices shown here are the current catalog price at the time this page was loaded. The price you're actually charged is always confirmed by our system at checkout — it may reflect a currently active promotion, and it can never be overridden by this website.

cart.emptyBody: Add a product from the shop to get started.
cart.title: Your Cart
cart.estimatedTotalNote: Estimated total (indicative — confirmed by our system at checkout)

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.subtitle: No account needed — just tell us where to deliver your order.
checkout.estimateNote: This is an estimate. The real, final price is computed by our system from the current catalog price at the moment you submit this order — it is never taken from this page.
checkout.phoneHint: Keep this handy — you'll need it (with your order reference) to track your order later.
checkout.paymentNote: Payment method: Cash on Delivery — the only option this demo supports. No card details or real payment information is ever collected by this site.

confirmation.noOrderBody: This page only shows the order you just placed, in this browser. If you already have an order reference, use Track Order instead.
confirmation.saveRefNote: Save this reference and the phone number you checked out with — you'll need BOTH to look up your order later on the Track Order page.

track.title: Track Your Order
track.subtitle: Enter the order reference you received at checkout AND the phone number you checked out with. Both are required — we never look up an order by reference alone, to protect your privacy.

footer.line1: Demo Consumer Distribution Co. — this is a demo storefront (ENTERPRISE_PLATFORM WEB-05, Phase 7). All products, prices, and orders shown here are live demo data generated and managed by the connected ERP system — this is a demo instance, not a commercial store.
footer.line2: Payment: Cash on Delivery only — this demo does not integrate any real payment gateway. No card details are ever collected by this site.

errors.missing_fields: Please fill in all required fields.
errors.backend_rejected: We couldn't complete this request. Please check your details and try again.
errors.missing_tracking_fields: Please enter both your order reference and phone number.
errors.lookup_failed: Could not look up this order. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
